sources.title: Transmission mechanism of monetary policy
sources.read: Policy rates, bank rates, credit supply, uncertainty and risk-taking sections.
sources.use: Treat25–50 basis-point loan-rate transmission as a scenario. Hold external borrowing and project appraisal rates fixed unless separately contracted.

sources.title: Bank of England Market Operations Guide: Our tools
sources.read: Facilities, operational readiness, eligibility and collateral risk-management sections.
sources.use: Separate temporary collateralized liquidity, appropriate haircuts, borrower qualification and implementation readiness from monetary easing. No terrestrial facility size is imported.
